tools.name: discover_repo
tools.description: Resolve and classify a GitHub repository for the FAI Harvest pipeline. Use this when the user wants to know whether a repo can be imported as a Solution Play, or asks about its stars / language / license / topics / FROOT layer. Accepts an HTTPS URL, an SSH URL, or `owner/repo` shorthand. Free — no sign-in required.

tools.name: extract_facts
tools.description: Extract the structured RepoFacts (regions / models / services / IaC) from a GitHub repository for the FAI Harvest pipeline, WITHOUT running the full import. Use this when the user wants to know what clouds, models, and services a repo uses, or to preview what harvest would detect. Accepts an HTTPS URL, an SSH URL, or `owner/repo` shorthand. Free — no sign-in required.

tools.name: retrieve_exemplars
tools.description: Find the top reference plays most similar to a GitHub repository — the exemplars the FAI Harvest scaffold step would use. Use this when the user asks 'what would FrootAI base this on?' or wants to preview the retrieval before importing. Returns a ranked list with similarity scores. Free — no sign-in required.

top_k.description: How many exemplars to return (default 5, max 20).

tools.name: list_plays
tools.description: Browse the FrootAI Orchard catalog of published Solution Plays. Use this when the user wants to see what plays exist, or asks for plays by cloud (variety), maturity (ripeness), or category. Returns a ranked Markdown table. Free — no sign-in required.

variety.description: Filter by cloud: azure / gcp / aws / oss / hybrid.

ripeness.description: Filter by maturity (e.g. Seedling / Sapling / Bearing / Mature).

category.description: Filter by category (e.g. rag / agent / voice / vision).

tools.name: import_accelerator
tools.description: Import a GitHub repository as a production-ready Solution Play — runs the full FAI Harvest pipeline server-side and returns a signed download URL for the generated ZIP. Requires a Pro subscription. Optionally pass `customizations` to apply your org's policy (regions / models / naming / tags / network / rbac / iac) before generating.

customizations.description: Optional policy overlay (the customize-wizard shape): regions / models / naming / tags / network / rbac / iac.

tools.name: customize_play
tools.description: Apply your org's policy overlay (regions / models / naming / tags / network / rbac / iac) to a published Solution Play and preview the result. Returns a 3-way diff (base vs upstream vs customized) plus a commit token to redeem the customized bundle. Requires a Pro subscription. Pass `policy_yaml` as the customize-wizard policy document.

play_slug.description: Slug of the published play to customize, e.g. `01-enterprise-rag`.

policy_yaml.description: The policy overlay as a YAML document (customize-wizard shape: regions / models / naming / tags / network / rbac / iac).

tools.name: re_harvest
tools.description: Re-run the FAI Harvest pipeline for an already-imported Solution Play at the current upstream HEAD and see what changed since your pinned version. Returns a version diff (pinned vs upstream) plus a signed URL to download the refreshed bundle. Requires a Pro subscription.

play_slug.description: Slug of the imported play to refresh, e.g. `01-enterprise-rag`.

tools.name: approve_play
tools.description: Founder-only: approve a reviewed play version and commit it to the public FrootAI Orchard marketplace catalog. Requires the `approve-play` entitlement (founder accounts only). Returns the published catalog entry and its listing URL.

play_slug.description: Slug of the pending play to approve, e.g. `42-acme-rag`.

version.description: The exact version to publish, e.g. `1.0.0`.

tools.name: list_pending_reviews
tools.description: List harvested plays that have not yet been committed to the marketplace. Mirrors `frootai orchard list-pending-reviews` ([H8.12]): walks the plays-root and returns slug + confidence + warnings + license-class for each pending play. Use `min_confidence` / `max_confidence` / `license_class` to filter the queue.

min_confidence.description: Only include plays with aggregate confidence >= this (0.0-1.0).

max_confidence.description: Only include plays with aggregate confidence <= this (0.0-1.0).

include_committed.description: Include plays already marked published (default: false).

limit.description: Cap the list to N entries (default: 50, max: 500).
